statistical_scope: descriptive paired family means on a finite constructed panel; no significance tests
prediction_failure: no imputation; cost-rule cell cannot execute; preserve other comparisons
transport_retry: only no usable model output and network/socket timeout, HTTP 429/5xx, or explicit transient provider error; elapsed deadline/worker failure/oversize outcomes never redrawn
scoring: independent committed-state reconstruction; episode-level loss at most L; no execution means no execution loss
enforcement_evidence_policy: current signed grant mandatory in every enforcement arm; receipt cannot replace an invalid or missing grant
accounting_window: each pilot episode is an isolated deployment with its fixture budget; cross-interaction serialization is tested offline
